say:1:1530137301:1.text: Guarding Wrathwood Grove, keeping watch for Halian tricks and raids.
say:1:1530137301:1.source_cn: 保卫树怒山谷，防止狡猾的呼临人潜入或者偷袭。
say:1:1530137301:1.male: Guarding Wrathwood Grove, keeping watch for Halian tricks and raids.
say:1:1530137301:1.female: Guarding Wrathwood Grove, keeping watch for Halian tricks and raids.

say:2:1530137302:1.text: I've fought the Halians before. I know their dirty tricks.
say:2:1530137302:1.source_cn: 我曾经在战场上和呼临人打过交道，他们的诡计瞒不过我。
say:2:1530137302:1.male: I've fought the Halians before. I know their dirty tricks.
say:2:1530137302:1.female: I've fought the Halians before. I know their dirty tricks.

say:3:1530137303:1.text: But look at my leg, it can't carry me in battle anymore. So I stay here in Wrathwood Grove, to guard the people.
say:3:1530137303:1.source_cn: 但是看看我的脚，它已经不能支撑我继续在战场上奔跑和跳跃...
say:3:1530137303:1.male: But look at my leg, it can't carry me in battle anymore. So I stay here in Wrathwood Grove, to guard the people.
say:3:1530137303:1.female: But look at my leg, it can't carry me in battle anymore. So I stay here in Wrathwood Grove, to guard the people.
